shortDescription: Resource module for Wireless Settings Dot11be Profiles

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: default
options.description: Specifies whether this 802.11be profile's properties should be set to system default profile on device(default-dot11be-profile) or not.When a profile is marked with default as true ,configuration is pushed to device's 'default-dot11be-profile'. Note Setting a profile as custom (default=false) on devices with IOS-XE versions below 17.18.1 will result in a provisioning failure.

options.name: muMimoDownLink
options.description: MU-MIMO Downlink (Default false). This parameter is deprecated in IOS-XE versions 17.18.2 and above and will be ignored during provisioning. For IOS-XE version above 17.18.2, use the 802.11ax properties in Advanced SSID Feature Template.

options.name: muMimoUpLink
options.description: MU-MIMO Uplink (Default false). This parameter is deprecated in IOS-XE versions 17.18.2 and above and will be ignored during provisioning. For IOS-XE version above 17.18.2, use the 802.11ax properties in Advanced SSID Feature Template.

options.name: ofdmaDownLink
options.description: OFDMA Downlink (Default true). This parameter is deprecated in IOS-XE versions 17.18.2 and above and will be ignored during provisioning. For IOS-XE version above 17.18.2, use the 802.11ax properties in Advanced SSID Feature Template.

options.name: ofdmaUpLink
options.description: OFDMA Uplink (Default true). This parameter is deprecated in IOS-XE versions 17.18.2 and above and will be ignored during provisioning. For IOS-XE version above 17.18.2, use the 802.11ax properties in Advanced SSID Feature Template.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
